The fixed row signs yield the exact ℓ∞→edge-Lipschitz operator norm with ±1 attainment. Strict convexity of (s-1)∫exp(sr)dr gives the unnormalized imbalanced>balanced order, while decreasing 1/a+1/b gives its normalized reversal. Intermediate exponents give strictly opposite small- and large-time orders; dividing the difference by t and using the implicit function theorem yields the stated short-time crossing expansion. Independent finite matrix exponentials verify representative formula and order cases, not all quantifiers.
